title: 261. Longest Valid Parentheses

examples.explanation: The trailing "()" is the longest valid block.
The block "()()" is valid and has length 4.
An empty string contains no pairs.

hints: Push indices of '(' onto a stack seeded with -1; on ')' pop and measure the distance to the new stack top.
Each time the stack empties, push the current index as the new base for future measurements.
